**Review of the about page draft**

- **"Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019."** This is on the allowlist.
- **"a small team of six"** Team size is a product fact that is fine as written.
- **"every tin is packed by hand in Bristol"** This is on the allowlist.
- **"Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars"** This is a problem. It is an invented statistic. The only backed rating claim is 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. A 98% five-star figure isn't supported and sounds stronger than the real rating. Replace it with "rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website."
- **"we buy from gardens we've visited"** This is a sourcing and origins statement, which counts as a product fact. It is fine as written, as long as the team has in fact visited those gardens.

**Verdict:** Don't publish until the 98% claim is replaced with the approved rating.

